briefdescription.para: Print current WDT notifier debug/validation counters and state.
Send the WDT test command to the RPU.

detaileddescription.para: Mirrors the Linux visp_mbox_wdt_send_test() flow, but uses the bare-metal mailbox Send_Command() path (same format as SetATM / INIT_FIRMWARE). The payload carries the instance id followed by the number of seconds the RPU should keep petting its WWDT before deliberately stopping, which lets the APU-side notifier observe the resulting WWDT0 expiry.

simplesect.para: RET_SUCCESS on success, error code otherwise.
